entities.name: Opiter Verginius Tricostus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Opiter Verginius Tricostus served as consul of the early Roman Republic in 502 BC, with Spurius Cassius Vecellinus. He was the first from the powerful Verginia family to obtain the consulship.
